# Stay Booked Marketing

Legal name: Stay Booked Marketing LLC. Phone: (813) 480-5818. Email: kolby@staybookedmarketing.com.

> Advertising and lead-generation agency for local businesses. Targeted Meta and Google campaigns, AI lead follow-up within five minutes, automated booking.

Industries served: Home Services & Contractors, Clubs & Nightlife, Law Firms, Lifestyle & Big Ticket, Financial Firms, Medical & Health, Rentals & Transactional, Restaurants, Brand & Product Promotion, Real Estate, Private Schools.

Pricing: quoted per business after a free 15-minute strategy call. No startup fee. If we don't hit the goal we set together within 90 days, we keep working for free until we do.
